title: Conditions of Hire: the Notice Period and the Shares Retained on Each Equipment Rental and Demo Package
content:
## Notice, retained shares and how long a reservation is held

These are the conditions the collective holds the guest to on each package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line where a reservation is given up or the kit is never collected.

| Your package | Free cancellation period, whole hours | Share retained after the deadline | Share retained where the kit is never collected | Reservation held for, whole hours |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 24 | 25 per cent | 50 per cent | 24 |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 24 | 25 per cent | 50 per cent | 24 |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 24 | 30 per cent | 60 per cent | 24 |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 48 | 40 per cent | 75 per cent | 48 |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 48 | 50 per cent | 100 per cent | 48 |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 168 | 20 per cent | 25 per cent | 72 |

### What each figure is

**Free cancellation period.** The whole hours before the collection date up to which a cancellation carries no fee.

**Share retained after the deadline.** The percentage of the agreement value the collective retains where a cancellation is recorded after that deadline.

**Share retained where the kit is never collected.** The percentage of the agreement value the collective retains where the guest never collects the kit.

**Reservation held for.** The whole hours a reservation is held before the kit set aside for it is released.

### Reading the conditions across the line

On the Junior, Basic and Sport packages the free cancellation period and the period a reservation is held are both 24 whole hours; on the Performance and Demo packages both stand at 48. The Season-Long Lease Package is the only package of the line on which the two differ: the free cancellation period is 168 whole hours and the reservation is held for 72.

On every package of the line the share retained where the kit is never collected is the larger of the two: 50 per cent against 25 per cent on the Junior and Basic packages, 60 per cent against 30 per cent on the Sport package, 75 per cent against 40 per cent on the Performance package, 100 per cent against 50 per cent on the Demo package and 25 per cent against 20 per cent on the Season-Long Lease Package. On four of them — the Junior, Basic, Sport and Demo packages — the uncollected share is exactly twice the cancellation share; on the Performance package and the Season-Long Lease Package it is less than twice it.

The Demo Ski & Board Rental carries the highest uncollected share of the line at 100 per cent of the agreement value, and the Season-Long Lease Package the lowest of the line at 25 per cent, against the lowest cancellation share of the line at 20 per cent.
